"''Kabbney sprouty-stouty tot on Raxus Prime. Junk colony. Much clangy-din makes temper thin. But opera? Balm-and-calm. "Killing of Gurk Mandrel?" Uff, smoothy-soothey overture. "Battle of Quade?" Eighty-nine, voice divine.|[[Tesh Keff Hawks]] and Kabbney Uppercut|''[[Star Wars Zero Company]]''}} '''Raxus Prime''', also known simply as '''Raxus''',''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' was a [[planet]] that served as a junk colony. It was located in the [[Raxus system]] within the [[Tion Hegemony]] of [[the galaxy]]'s [[Outer Rim Territories]]. During the [[Republic Era]], the [[Felshi]] [[Kabbney Uppercut]] grew up on Raxus Prime as a [[youngling]]. However, the colony's work proved to be very loud and resulted in Uppercut developing a short temper. In response, Uppercut sought solace in opera, listening to pieces like the "[[Killing of Gurk Mandrel]]" and "[[Battle of Quade]]" to relax. After the [[Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire|early Rebel Alliance]] was rejected by the [[Grand Hutt Council]] and the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild]] for a potential alliance against the [[Galactic Empire]], [[General]] [[Davits Draven]] sent a message to [[Commander-in-Chief]] [[Mon Mothma]] where he suggested the [[Mining Guild]], adding that he believed the Alliance could secure concessions of safe passage from the Guild and at a lower cost than Mothma might've thought. Draven then supplied a map with active investigations into Mining Guild operations carried out by the Alliance, one which was at Raxus Prime. ==Behind the scenes== Raxus Prime was first mentioned in the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the trivia gallery for the [[2010]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Heroes on Both Sides]]." In [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]], [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] first appeared in the [[2002]] video game [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']] developed by Pandemic Studios.[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' video game]] ==Appearances== *''[[Star Wars Zero Company]]'' {{Mo}} *{{StoryCite|story=The Backup Backup Plan|book=From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back|audiobook=1}} {{Mo}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/heroes-on-both-sides-episode-guide|text="Heroes on Both Sides" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} {{1stm}} *{{BuildFalconCite|62|Guide to the Galaxy}} *''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' {{1stp}} *''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'' *{{GalaxyMapPoster}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Raxus Prime |fr=Raxus Prime |hu=Raxus Prime |ja=ラクサス・プライム }} [[Category:Junk planets]] [[Category:Planets in the Outer Rim Territories]] [[Category:Planets in the Slice]] [[Category:Raxus system locations]] {{RelatedCategories |[[Category:Raxus Prime locations]] }}
